digest.component_or_area: plan review attestation and manifest encoding
propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic pin per direct child and per prerequisite, encoded in the manifest with role, canonical ticket ID, and 16-hex material fingerprint.

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all ticket states store-wide including archived records to discover inbound blockers, resolve aliases/prefixes once, and normalize both prerequisite directions to role=prerequisite.
Duplicate edges within a role collapse to one pin; targets in both child and prerequisite roles receive exactly two pins sorted lexicographically.

Pin collection must run before prerequisite LLM evaluation; any unreadable/unresolvable target raises PlanRelationSnapshotError with specific reason enum (missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, store-read-failure) and returns unsigned INDETERMINATE without traceback.
tracker_head_sha() must verify clean tickets-tracker state using git status --porcelain plus ls-files -u, then return 40-hex HEAD SHA, mapping all git/IO/path/output failures to store-read-failure.

All signing paths (ordinary sign_plan_review, refresh_attestation, resign_plan_review) must call collect_plan_relation_snapshot() unconditionally and pass related_material to build_manifest(); legacy unpinned manifests remain readable but new reviews always require complete pins.
